work.title: Swan Lake, Op.20 — Act II Pt.1 (theme excerpt)
work.source_credit: European Archive, via Musopen and Wikimedia Commons
work.performer_identity: The source lists European Archive; individual orchestra, conductor, and recording date are not identified.

rights.basis: The Commons file page identifies the recording as sourced from Musopen, credits European Archive, and applies the Creative Commons Public Domain Mark. This is the source listing, not a new project license grant.
rights.verification_scope: Primary Commons file description and Creative Commons PDM deed checked; legacy Musopen URL is404, current work page resolves. Individual recording provenance is not supplied by the source.
rights.attribution: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, Swan Lake Op.20 — European Archive / Musopen, via Wikimedia Commons (Public Domain Mark1.0). Excerpt, gain, fades and MP3 transcode by JC04_dancing.

excerpt.selection_rationale: One continuous original-speed excerpt contains the repeated Swan Lake theme, a quieter response, a dynamic build, a climax, and a fading response. Boundaries were selected from waveform and spectrogram structure.

copyright=Public Domain Mark 1.0, per source listing
reproduction.note: Download source URL and verify sourceSHA256. Substitute an FFmpeg executable supporting libmp3lame. Filter timestamps refer to the original recording.

choreography_timing.time_origin: excerpt start; add the video preparation offset to obtain video time
choreography_timing.method: Manual selection from0.12-second RMS envelopes and4096-sample STFT spectrograms at22050Hz. Anchors are approximate structural cues, not score-derived barlines or independently verified beats.

phrase_anchors.label: theme_reprise
phrase_anchors.rationale: Start of the strong repeated theme; first sustained harmonic band at approximately source 55.2s.

phrase_anchors.label: theme_answer_1
phrase_anchors.rationale: Chosen near the next repeated dynamic pulse around source 62.1s.

phrase_anchors.label: theme_answer_2
phrase_anchors.rationale: Chosen near the matching repeated pulse around source 69.0s.

phrase_anchors.label: theme_answer_3
phrase_anchors.rationale: Chosen near the closing repeated pulse around source 76.0s.

phrase_anchors.label: quiet_response
phrase_anchors.rationale: Envelope drops into a lower-energy responding passage near source 80s.

phrase_anchors.label: expansion
phrase_anchors.rationale: Higher spectral density and a further dynamic rise around source 109.6s.

phrase_anchors.label: climax_peak
phrase_anchors.rationale: Largest 0.12s RMS window in this excerpt occurs at source 121.08s, approximately excerpt 65.9s.

phrase_anchors.label: release
phrase_anchors.rationale: Sharp amplitude reduction after the climax at approximately source 122.6s.

phrase_anchors.label: final_response
phrase_anchors.rationale: Late response pulse centered around source 129s.

phrase_anchors.label: reverence
phrase_anchors.rationale: Marked decrescendo and thinning of the spectrum around source 142s.

phrase_anchors.label: fade_out
phrase_anchors.rationale: Start of the applied 2.8s output fade.
